mapper.select: SELECT r.request_id, r.group_id, r.user_key, u.nickname, r.status, r.requested_at, r.approved_at, r.reject_reason FROM group_join_request r JOIN `user` u ON u.user_key = r.user_key WHERE r.group_id = #{groupId} AND r.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY r.requested_at ASC
SELECT request_id, group_id, user_key, status, requested_at, approved_at, reject_reason FROM group_join_request WHERE status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY requested_at ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM group_join_request r JOIN `user` u ON u.user_key = r.user_key JOIN `group` g ON g.group_id = r.group_id WHERE r.status = 'PENDING'
AND (u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%') OR g.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%'))
AND r.requested_at >= #{from}
AND r.requested_at < DATE_ADD(#{to}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
SELECT user_key FROM group_join_request WHERE request_id = #{requestId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM group_join_request WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND user_key = #{userKey} AND status = 'PENDING'
